Bel-Air (12e arr.) — Paris, France

🟡 Local press research

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

On the evening of 8 November 2025, a 14-year-old was attacked and cut by four assailants on avenue du Général-Michel-Bizot (around 7:50pm) as part of what press described as a 'rixe entre bandes' (rival-gang confrontation); a second teenager was stabbed in a related incident the same night, and several suspects were arrested. This falls within Bel-Air. It reads as an isolated, youth-gang-linked flare-up rather than a recurring pattern for the quartier as a whole, so it's flagged for evenings without pushing to red; daytime shows nothing of concern. Sources checked: Le Parisien (via CNews/Fdesouche relay), rixe entre bandes, rue/avenue Michel-Bizot, 8 Nov 2025.
